title: Mike Y NDE 4655
content: I was in severe pain and had not slept in many nights except for fitful efforts to find a body position to relieve the nerve pain I was experiencing. I passed out and immediately found myself in a large tube with highly polished sides that were like graphite (pencil lead). The sides were extremely polished and smooth. My conscious feelings were ecstatic. I was out of pain and felt absolutely WHOLE! My whole being was elevated and I felt better than anything I had ever experienced. As I went through the tunnel my whole life experience flashed in front of me, I would say every experience, and I saw how God had made them all work towards His good and perfect plans. I felt totally loved, accepted, secure, and happy. All of the tunnel travel was spent approaching a great light that I perceived as God, Jesus, or perfect love. I was conscious that I was in a new dimension but did not think back to my former existence. I was just here, where I was at the moment. There were no decisions to come back or not, I do remember wondering of it but then I awoke or came back. I can state with certainty that this was not a dream; it was a life experience. You do not remember dreams with this much clarity, vividness, and duration in time. I am sharing this off the cuff eight years later and it is like yesterday that it happened.
